subject: gk
question: Which of the following Articles establishes the provision of the Right to Education?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 21A**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Article 21A includes children in the age group of six to fourteen years as a Fundamental Right in such a manner as the State may, by law, determine. 
 
• The RTE Act provides for the **Right of children to free and compulsory education** till the completion of elementary education in a neighborhood school.
 
• It states that ‘compulsory education’ means the obligation of the appropriate government to provide free elementary education and ensure compulsory admission, attendance, and completion of elementary education to every child in the six to fourteen age group.
 
• ‘Free’ means that** no child shall be liable to pay any kind of fee or charges or expenses **which may prevent him or her from **pursuing and completing elementary education.**
 
• It was inserted in the Constitution of India by the **Eighty-sixth Amendment Act, 2002**.
